verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's CLI and server directly support the `-hf` flag to pull models straight from Hugging Face repos (e.g. `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF`, `llama serve -hf ...`), confirmed by first-party GitHub docs, and community evidence corroborates users running downloaded GGUF models successfully across platforms. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the `-hf` download flow (community anecdotes describe manual downloads/compiling rather than the HF flag itself), and no mention of gating/auth token handling for private HF repos.
